sources.note: Comparative sound-change notes on Harzandi (t > r, ž > y, ö/ə phoneme, x > h, fr > hr); the only 'stress' mention concerns Northern Ṭāleši ('dropping or greatly reducing of unstressed syllables'). Nothing on Harzandi stress.

sources.note: Nothing on stress; states nine vowel phonemes, consonants as in Persian, case, split ergativity, SOV.

sources.citation: Mortażavi, Manučehr. 1345 [1966]. "Āsār va asnād-e marbut be zabān-e dirin-e Āẕarbāyjān". Našriye-ye Dāneškade-ye Adabiyāt-e Tabriz 27(116): 445-479. (Persian)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; historical survey that names Harzani (Galin-Qaya) as the most archaic surviving Azari island and refers the reader to his own 'Nokte-i čand az zabān-e Harzani' (Našriye 6/3) and 'Feʿl dar zabān-e Harzani' (winter 1341 and spring 1342 issues).

sources.citation: Zokāʾ, Yaḥyā. 1336 [1957]. "Guyeš-e Galin-Qaya yā Harzandi". Farhang-e Irānzamin 5: 51-92. (Persian)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Preface, village description, transcription key (p. 56 = PDF p. 6: 'حروف صدادار' a ā e o ö u ü i ə, consonants; note only on č/k/g and ö/ü), then a thematic vocabulary and sentences in Persian script + Latin transcription without stress marks. scanned a full-text search for stress/accent: no تکیه.

sources.note: Nothing; remarks on vowel assimilation, palatalized k, intervocalic -t- > -r-, enclitics, verb forms. No occurrence of 'stress' or 'accent'.

sources.citation: Kārang, ʿAbd-al-ʿAli. 1333 [1953/54]. Tāti va Harzani: do lahja az zabān-e bāstān-e Āẕarbāyjān. Tabriz: Esmāʿil Vāʿezpur. 160 pp. (Persian)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Contents: introduction on the old language of Azerbaijan, Latin alphabet key (pp. 36-37, PDF pp. 41-42: consonants and vowels only, no stress symbol), Tati/Harzani vocabulary, grammar of Tati and of Harzani (pp. 106ff: noun, pronoun, adjective, numeral, adverb, particles, verb), sentence specimens. Whole scanned text a full-text search for stress/accent تکیه/فشار/آکسان/آهنگ: no stress statement; transcriptions unmarked for stress.
